* [Key Position & Outlook] L3Harris-managed infrastructure requires significant modernization.

## Section 3: Flagship Technical Dissections

### Claude Code CLI & Terminal Autonomous Agent: Architecture, Shell Sandboxing & Enterprise Cost Optimization
